svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Close on the demonstrated change: a pinned real Hive runtime now invokes the same contracts and recovers across actual caller and worker process death. The consumer remains backend-independent, DA remains application-neutral, owner commits remain separate, and current authority still applies on replay. A fixture is labelled as a fixture; a historical chain observation does not become a new real-caller chain pass. The complete evidence, exact sources, build recipe and failure history are available in the repository. This presentation updates the explanation of completed M1.1/M1.2 work; it adds no runtime or cognitive implementation. Pause for discussion before the appendices.
svg.text: The native integration preserves the original boundaries.
Providers remain replaceable by exact contract.
Each receipt names an observed, bounded guarantee.
Real Hive + real local DeTTa • Fixture counterparty • Chain NOT_RUN • Stop before M2
